title.text: Budapest: Communist History Tour with House of Terror Option

pills.label: 2 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 2 hours.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English.

pills.summary_html: 🎟️ 3 options, entry included▾
pills.pop_html: Choose your version: Morning: communism walking tour plus a 1-hour guided visit to the Budapest Retro Center. Afternoon: the same walk plus a House of Terror ticket to visit on your own. Third option: a guided tour inside the House of Terror. The museum ticket comes from your guide, not the ticket office.

The walk: Starts at Parliament with the monument to the victims of the red dictatorship, then Liberty Square and the Soviet Liberation Memorial (the last communist monument in its original place), the windows where Cardinal Mindszenty spent his exile, the ventilation channels of a Cold War nuclear bunker and 1956 revolution sites.

Inside the museum: The former seat of the ÁVO state security police. On the guided option you cover WWII, Nazi rule and Soviet occupation, 1950s daily life, the interrogation and torture cells, the director's office, deportations, labour camps, political trials, 1956 and the end of communism in 1989.

Group: Small group capped at 10, English-speaking guide trained in history. The guide is independent, not museum staff. Meeting point depends on the option you pick and is shown when you check availability.

pills.label: Skip the ticket queue
pills.pop_html: Skip the ticket queue: your entry is booked in advance.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want communist Budapest and a museum in one go without leaving the centre, because €50 covers a guided walk plus a Retro Center or House of Terror entry in a group of 10
best_for.skip_html: if Memento Park's statues are what you came for; this tour stays in the city centre

items.a: Depends on the option selected.

Walk plus museum entry in one price. Choice of House of Terror (guided or self-visit) or the hands-on Retro Center. Max 10 people with a history-trained guide.

title.text: Memento Park: Official Guided Tour with Entry Ticket

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English.

The route: Starts at Witness Square in front of the park, then Stalin's Grandstand and its hidden rooms, the view from the Waving Balcony, the Statue Park's propaganda figures of workers and communist leaders, and ends at the End Wall. Questions are welcome; the programme is interactive.

Ticket: Admission to Memento Park and its premises plus the guided tour. Show your ticket at the desk in the park, then join the group. Afterwards the time is yours for photos, the souvenir shop, the film show and exhibitions in The Most Cheerful Barrack.

pills.summary_html: 🚌 ~40 min by public transport▾
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Memento Park is on the outskirts of Budapest and the guide meets you in the park, so you make your own way there. Public transport takes about 40 minutes. Transport and tips are not part of this ticket.

pills.summary_html: ☔ Rain or shine, ages 10+▾
pills.pop_html: Good to know: Runs in all weather on gravel paths, so wear comfortable shoes and weather-appropriate clothing (sunscreen in summer). Not suitable for children under 10. English-speaking guide.

pills.label: Skip the ticket queue
pills.pop_html: Skip the ticket queue: your entry is booked in advance.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who can handle a 40-minute public transport trip and want the statues explained, because €24 gets you entry plus a guided walk for €14.50 more than the bare ticket
best_for.skip_html: if you do not want to deal with getting out to District XXII, or you are travelling with kids under 10

You get yourself there, about 40 minutes each way. Guided part is about 70 minutes of the 2 hours. Not suitable for children under 10.

title.text: Budapest: Memento Park and Icons of Communism Guided Tour

pills.label: 3 hours
pills.pop_html: Duration: 3 hours.

pills.label: 2 languages
pills.pop_html: Live guide in English and German.

pills.label: Wheelchair-friendly
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ✓ listed as wheelchair-accessible

pills.summary_html: 🚗 Car there and back▾
pills.pop_html: Transport: Pick-up at Batthyány tér and transport by car to Memento Park, 16 km (10 miles) from the city, then back to the city after the tour. No buses to work out.
Group: The only Memento Park option here with a stated group cap: 7 people. Live licensed guide in English or German. Listed as wheelchair-accessible.

pills.summary_html: 🗿 41 statues, Stalin's boots▾
pills.pop_html: What you see: The open-air museum holds 41 statues and icons of the communist past, including Marx, Engels and Lenin. In front of Stalin's Grandstand the guide explains how the crowd pulled down the dictator's statue, leaving only his boots, and how the secret police recruited and intimidated people.
Included: Memento Park entrance fee, the guide and a bottle of water. Souvenirs and food are not included. The guide will take photos of you with the statues free of charge.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Transport by car to Memento Park and back; Entrance fee to Memento Park; Live licensed guide; A bottle of water.Not included: Souvenirs; Food.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and families short on time who want Memento Park without the bus, because the car from Batthyány tér, entry, guide and water are all in one €59 price
best_for.skip_html: if you are on a budget and comfortable with public transport; the official guided tour plus a bus ticket costs far less

items.a: Batthyány tér, 1011 Budapest.

price.note: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before. The final price shows before you pay.

pills.label: Not step-free
pills.pop_html: ♿ Wheelchair: ✕ not suitable for wheelchair users

What the ticket covers: Admission to Memento Park, the photo exhibition and film show in The Most Cheerful Barrack (including the documentary "The Life of an Agent" about the secret service), and the storage showroom and art exhibition under Stalin's Boots.

Highlights: A replica of the grandstand that stood on the old Parade Square where party leaders watched socialist holiday parades, the propaganda statues of labour-movement figures and Red Army soldiers, and Lenin, all set up here after they were removed from Budapest's streets.
Fun part: An original Trabant car you can sit in for photos, plus the classic selfie with Lenin or the Soviet soldiers.

Flexibility: The ticket is valid for one day and skips the ticket queue, so you go at your own pace. Paths are gravel and may not suit wheelchair users. No guide and no transport: you make your own way to the park.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: Admission to Memento Park; Photo exhibition and film show in The Most Cheerful Barrack; Exhibition under Stalin's Boots; An original Trabant car for photos.Not included: Transport; Guided tour.

best_for.skip_html: if you want the statues explained or do not want to organise the 40-minute trip out; add a guide or the car transfer instead

Who leads it: Guides are professors, doctoral students, historians, journalists, art critics and published authors. The guide uses an iPad and old photos to show how streets looked under Stalin compared with today.
Getting around: Tram and metro tickets are included. The route uses the metro twice and a short ride on one of the old Stalin-era trolleybuses to Dózsa György út, the former May Day parade boulevard.

pills.summary_html: 🗺️ Bem tér → House of Terror▾
pills.pop_html: Route: Bem József Square (first big 1956 demonstration) and a coffeehouse with its 1960s interior, Kossuth Square's 1956 monuments, Freedom Square's Cold War landmarks, a 1970s housing estate, Socialist Realist statues at the former People's Stadium, ending outside the House of Terror with its slab of the Berlin Wall.

pills.summary_html: 🔒 Private or small group▾
pills.pop_html: Format: Private or small-group versions are available, and pickup is available on some options; check availability to see what your date offers. The final price can vary with date and number of participants. English.

pills.label: What's included
pills.pop_html: Included: 3-hour walking tour; Historian guide.Not included: Tram and metro tickets.

pills.label: Pickup available
pills.pop_html: Pickup available on this listing: choose it when you book.

best_for.pick_html: for history buffs who want everyday life under "Goulash Communism" explained by an academic, because it is the only tour that goes out to a 1970s housing estate and the stadium statues
best_for.skip_html: if you want a museum visit or Memento Park in the price, or €105 per person is more than you want to spend
